## Change

Describe the protocol, product, or documentation change.

## Invariants affected

Identify the security, payment, identity, verification, or reputation invariants touched by this change.

## Failure and abuse cases

Describe how the change behaves under malformed input, replay, timeout, partial failure, collusion, and unauthorized access.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] Schemas and examples remain aligned.
- [ ] No unfinished markers or filler copy were introduced.
- [ ] Human intervention points are explicit.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and migration behavior are documented.
